Background: opaque muted olive (#5b6047) with very subtle pixel texture, no scenery. Expression: warm, relaxed small smile. No party hat or other headwear, no objects, no second person, no frame, no text, no signature, no watermark. This will be the style anchor for a matching set of eight portraits.
